newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan May trade deficit falls to $254 million.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan May trade deficit falls to $254 million.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit fell to a provisional $254 million in May from $276 million in April, but rose compared to $148 million in May 1996, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
Exports increased 3.4 percent to a provisional $707 million in May from $684 million in April, but decreased 17.5 percent compared to $857 million in May 1996.
Imports increased 0.1 percent to $961 million in May from $960 million in April but decreased 4.4 percent compared to $1.005 billion in May 1996.

The trade gap rose to a provisional $3.149 billion in July-May from $2.974 billion in the year-ago period. Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery, chemicals and petroleum products.
